description: Open-source reference monorepo for end-to-end MLOps on Snowflake, centered around Snowflake-native MLOps tooling (Feature Store, Model Registry, Tasks) in a hub-spoke layout. Questions, issues, or ideas about Snowflake ML in general are warmly welcomed.
